meta.title: Mori — Notes for Mac
meta.description: Mori is a notes app for Mac. You write in Markdown, link one note to another, and everything is saved as files on your computer.
meta.ogTitle: Mori — Where your ideas take shape
meta.ogDescription: A notes app for Mac. Every note is a file of your own, in a folder on your computer.

manifesto.sub: Mori is a Markdown notes app for Mac. Write your way, link your ideas, and keep everything in files you own.

one.title: Jot it down
one.text: Mori opens fast and drops you on a blank page.

two.title: Connect your ideas
two.text: One note leads to another with links and tags, the way thinking moves.

three.title: Keep it your way
three.text: Everything in .md files in your folder, no account and no cloud.

features.title: Made for people who think by writing.
features.intro: No blocks, no databases, no dashboards. Just text, the way it has always worked, with what it was missing to grow.

markdown.title: Markdown, minus the marks.
markdown.desc: The symbols show up while you type and tuck themselves away right after. You write in Markdown and read only the text.
markdown.demo: A note being written in Mori: each piece of Markdown shows up as it’s typed and disappears once the cursor leaves it.

links.title: Connect your notes.
links.desc: Link anything to anything: ideas, people, places, books and whatever comes next.

own.title: Your thoughts are yours.
own.desc: Everything stays on your computer. Open it in any app, today or twenty years from now.

themes.title: Make your notes shine.
themes.desc: Themes crafted with care to make writing even more special.

forest.title: Porch garden
forest.text: The basil took. The cherry tomatoes still haven’t made up their minds.

tags.title: Organize with nested tags
tags.text: One note in more than one place at the same time

offline.title: Offline-first
offline.text: No cloud, no account and no internet required

search.title: Instant search
search.text: Finds the note before you finish typing

focus.title: Focus mode
focus.text: Hide the interface with a shortcut and write without distractions

keys.title: Built for the keyboard
keys.text: Keyboard navigation and a command palette that speeds everything up

code.title: Code and diagrams
